title: Hitokoto
description: A plugin that placeholding Hitokoto JSON in server
body:
"Hitokoto" plugin
Currently implemented features: 

1, the statement library for the local deployment, administrators can arbitrarily select the desired statement classification, and can prevent network problems lead to failure to obtain statements 

2, asynchronous loading, to prevent the occupation of the server's main thread

3, compatible with a variety of server, PlaceholderAPI and other front for the soft dependency (not installed PlaceholderAPI can also be used in the case of the basic functions) 

4, flexible configuration file, support for switching a word function and reload configuration 

5, lightweight, powerful, only need to deploy the statement library can be used directly 

6, the administrator can set or send a specific word to a specific player 

7, will continue to update with the version 

8, clear permissions nodes and command usage 

9, the administrator can view the player's one word information 

Ready to add the following features: 

1, as a precursor to other plug-ins, through the call to the plug-in API, you can use any other plug-in 

2, support for switching between the local database or the online database 

4, support for modification of the plug-in available or disabled category function

5, multi-language support, version update detection, etc. 

Tutorial: 
When loading the plug-in for the first time, please download the json file from the official website of the statement library and put it into the plugins\Hitokoto\jsons folder, enter "/hitokoto reload" reload plugin can be used 

On the placeholder and PAPI placeholder and other details of the operation of the content see plug-in Configuration file
